findings.fix: The ruled class rule (contract, rulings 2026-11-07 22:52 IST): a patch that changes the value of a field that is not a true/false flag makes a sample row the person's: drop sample. plans.update drops it then; plans.debrief and predictions.complete always write the person's words or score, so they always drop it. A patch that changes nothing, or only true/false flags (todos.done; contacts' active from showContact or deactivate), keeps the mark. One helper used by every update verb. Tests per verb, red first: loadSample, the verb, the row unmarked, eraseSample keeps it; todos.done on a sample to-do keeps the mark and eraseSample removes it; contacts.update(id, {active: true}) on a sample contact keeps the mark.

findings.scenario: contacts.update deletes sample on every patch, a patch that changes nothing included: a person who opens 'Asha (sample)' and taps Save without editing (trunk ui-workbook.js:319 sends the whole form) makes it theirs, so Erase sample leaves 'Asha (sample)' with its made-up note in their Safety Net (probe 3 P5).
findings.fix: Covered by RS37R's helper: contacts.update drops the mark only when some non-flag key of the patch differs from the stored row (compare by value). Test: contacts.update(sampleId, {name: <the same name>}) keeps sample: true and eraseSample removes it; the RS37 test stays green.
